Zhang San was waiting for someone, but the sun was so warm today that he accidentally dozed off and missed their meeting. Still, the Soul Pursuer showed up.

The tea beside him had gone cold, and his favorite song, "Seven Friends," had been playing on repeat for a long time. As the year winds down, everyone is busy making plans for New Year's Eve and the arrival of the new year. In this gentle warmth, he reflects on the past year, amazed at how quickly time has flown, and takes stock of everything he's accomplished.

This has probably been my most fulfilling year yet—balancing school and part-time work at a steady pace. I no longer have to constantly ask my family for money. I'm finally learning to take charge of my own life. I always knew managing the everyday stuff wasn't easy, but I didn't truly realize how tough it really is. Growing up means learning to swallow the bitter with the sweet, finding joy along the way, and learning to stay steady no matter what.
